title: Secure User Authentication
specification_summary: Role-based JWT authentication for farmer, provider, worker, and admin roles with password hashing.
verification_method: Automated test suite + RBAC security verification script

title: Farmer and Farm Profiles
specification_summary: Farmer profiles with multiple farms, parcel fields, soil types, and acreage tracking.

title: Adult Service-Provider and Worker Profiles
specification_summary: Profiles for machinery providers and field workers, equipment listings, wage rates, and age verification.

title: Administrative Provider Verification
specification_summary: Administrative desk for verifying, rejecting, or suspending providers with mandatory audit notes.

title: Six Editable Crop Workflows
specification_summary: Six core crops (Wheat, Paddy, Sugarcane, Mustard, Maize, Potato) across 9 templates with DAG dependencies.

title: Farm Project Manager
specification_summary: End-to-end farm project coordination, operation sequencing, progress calculation, and status tracking.

title: Agricultural Service Discovery
specification_summary: Directory of 16 canonical categories, machinery providers, and field labour matching by village/district.

title: Quotations and Bookings
specification_summary: Service requests, multiple itemized quotations, single quote acceptance, booking lifecycle.

title: Availability and Scheduling
specification_summary: Resource reservation window, provider availability tracking, conflict and double-booking detection.
notes_and_caveats: Both exclusive and shared reservations supported.

title: Cancellation and Completion Workflows
specification_summary: Two-step completion workflow (provider submits -> farmer confirms) and cancellation with policy rules.
notes_and_caveats: Booking events logged in audit trail.

title: Farm Financial Planner
specification_summary: Full project ledger separating estimates, commitments, incurred costs, advances, refunds, and surplus.

title: Administrative Management and Complaints
specification_summary: Admin oversight of users, provider verification desk, complaint desk, and dispute resolution.
notes_and_caveats: Audit logs created for verification changes.

title: Hindi and English Core Interfaces
specification_summary: Bilingual support with persistent language context switcher across all operational views.
notes_and_caveats: Dual-language keys for crops and categories.

title: Historical Agricultural Reference Integration
specification_summary: Import and query canonical datasets: 16 categories, 27 machinery rates, 22 wage trends, 360 reference records.

title: Multiple Quotations Discovery
specification_summary: Multiple registered and verified providers can discover and quote on open service requests.

title: Single Accepted Booking per Request
specification_summary: Only one active accepted booking may fulfil an individual service request; competing quotes rejected.

title: Itemized Quotation Breakdown
specification_summary: Quotations must include quantity, billing unit, unit price, itemized charges, and server-calculated total.
notes_and_caveats: Client amounts cannot override server arithmetic.

title: Quotation Versioning and Expiry Validation
specification_summary: Expected quotation version must match, and expired quotations must be strictly rejected.
notes_and_caveats: Quotation.is_expired() UTC vs IST midnight date boundary defect. Preserved per Section 02.

title: Resource Reservation Window
specification_summary: Tentative resource reservation created on quotation acceptance with explicit start and end windows.

title: Concurrency Protection & Race Prevention
specification_summary: Multi-connection database row-level locking via select_for_update() to prevent race conditions.
notes_and_caveats: PostgreSQL concurrency guarantees NOT VERIFIED locally due to SQLite environment limitation.

title: Double-Booking Prevention
specification_summary: Exclusive machinery resources and provider calendar strictly protected against overlapping reservations.
notes_and_caveats: 409 Conflict returned on attempted double booking.

title: Schedule Conflict Detection
specification_summary: Detection of overlapping provider bookings or farmer field conflicts across identical dates.

title: Idempotent Quotation Acceptance
specification_summary: Retrying an identical quotation acceptance request with same idempotency key returns cached result.

title: Conflict on Idempotency Key Reuse
specification_summary: Reusing an existing idempotency key with a mutated payload returns HTTP 409 Conflict.

title: Advance Payment Tracking
specification_summary: Advance payments linked to booking commitments with payment method and reference logging.
notes_and_caveats: Advances tracked separately from final settlements.

title: Final Settlement Tracking
specification_summary: Recording final payments against incurred expenditure, updating outstanding balance.

title: Refund Reconciliation
specification_summary: Refunds reduce net payments and balance ledger accurately upon dispute or cancellation.

title: Backup Provider Suggestions
specification_summary: Automated suggestion of alternative verified providers when a primary booking is cancelled.

title: Suspended Provider Quote Block
specification_summary: Administratively suspended providers and workers are strictly prohibited from submitting quotes.

title: Booking State Machine Transitions
specification_summary: Strict state transitions: pending -> confirmed -> in_progress -> completion_pending -> completed.

title: Cancellation Penalty and Cutoff Window
specification_summary: Validation of 24h cancellation deadline and calculation of penalty charges for late cancellations.

title: Rescheduling Notice Window Validation
specification_summary: Rescheduling requests require mandatory notice window and mutual agreement.

title: Two-Step Completion Workflow
specification_summary: Provider submits service completion; Farmer conducts field inspection and approves or disputes.
verification_method: Automated two-step test & E2E workflow script
notes_and_caveats: No premature completion without farmer sign-off.

title: Booking Event Audit Trail
specification_summary: Immutable audit trail logging all lifecycle state transitions, actors, timestamps, and notes.

title: Planned Estimates Tracking
specification_summary: Independent tracking of planned budget estimates without combining with commitments or incurred costs.

title: Confirmed Commitments on Booking
specification_summary: Automatic creation of commitment expense upon quotation acceptance, tracking allocated capital.

title: Incurred Expenditure on Completion
specification_summary: Transition of commitment to incurred expenditure upon confirmed service completion.

title: Advance Payments Tracking
specification_summary: Separate recording of advance disbursements against confirmed commitments.

title: Partial & Final Payments Tracking
specification_summary: Recording partial and final milestone settlements linked to incurred expenses.

title: Outstanding Balance Calculation
specification_summary: Accurate calculation: outstanding_balance = max(0, incurred_expenditure - net_recorded_payments).
notes_and_caveats: Exact match on mandatory test fixture.

title: Overpayment / Refundable Balance
specification_summary: When payments exceed incurred cost, outstanding balance is clamped to 0 and overpayment tracked.

title: Cancellation Release of Unutilized Commitment
specification_summary: Cancelling an unfulfilled service booking releases its commitment from the farm project financial summary.

title: Financial Adjustment Audit Trail
specification_summary: Post-service adjustments (e.g. area mismatch, fuel surcharge) recorded with audit reason and approver ID.

title: Decimal Precision & Currency Arithmetic
specification_summary: Strict Python Decimal(10, 2) arithmetic; no binary floating point drift or rounding distortions.

title: Refund Tracking & Balance Reconciliation
specification_summary: Refund transactions recorded against expenses, reducing net recorded payments.

title: Realized Revenue & Net Surplus Calculation
specification_summary: Crop mandi sale revenues recorded; net surplus = revenue - incurred expenditure with disclaimer.

title: Land Intelligence
specification_summary: Operational land area, administrative district, and village records.

title: Soil Intelligence
specification_summary: Manual soil report parameter records (alluvial, black, sandy loam, etc.).
notes_and_caveats: Manual farmer entry; no automated satellite chemistry.

title: Seed Intelligence
specification_summary: Farmer-entered variety and procurement records linked to crop projects.

title: Weather Intelligence
specification_summary: Read-only weather integration stub / advisory display.
notes_and_caveats: Read-only advisory; external live API stubbed for isolation.

title: Crop Monitoring
specification_summary: Manual observations and notes on project operations.

title: Post-Harvest Records
specification_summary: Transportation, storage, and mandi sale records.
notes_and_caveats: Revenue records track quintals and mandi prices.

title: Farm Analytics
specification_summary: Descriptive project and financial summaries (cost per acre, budget variance).
notes_and_caveats: Descriptive summaries only; no unvalidated AI projections.

title: Government Connect Directory
specification_summary: Official agricultural scheme directory and reference contacts.

title: Advanced Satellite Monitoring
specification_summary: Automated satellite imagery and NDVI spectral vegetative analysis.

title: Automated Chemical Recommendations
specification_summary: Algorithmic or automated pesticide/fertilizer dosage recommendations.
notes_and_caveats: Deferred to prevent uncertified chemical advice.

title: GPS-Derived Exact Soil Chemistry
specification_summary: Automated sensor-derived NPK and micronutrient precision mapping.

title: Automated Yield and Profitability Predictions
specification_summary: Machine-learning blackbox models forecasting crop yields and profits.
notes_and_caveats: Explicitly deferred; only descriptive analytics permitted.

title: Lending and Insurance
specification_summary: Integrated micro-credit origination, credit scoring, and crop insurance.

title: Actual Payment Collection Gateway
specification_summary: Real commercial banking/UPI payment gateway settlement.
notes_and_caveats: MVP records synthetic operational payments only.

title: Live Group Booking
specification_summary: Coordinated collective booking across multiple smallholder farmers.

title: Commercial Marketplace Launch
specification_summary: Public multi-vendor commercial agritech marketplace.
